role: Declares the overworld populate driver: the PopulateProbe stage ids and hook, the structure start and HashMap-ordered structure map records, the populate state (world, population Random, noise, four maps, End rand), the global world-Random and Det hooks the structure pieces use, and every call part of ChunkProviderGenerate.populate.

structs.name: struct populate
structs.java: ChunkProviderGenerate's populate state: rand, the two placement longs, BiomeGenBase's temperature and flower noise, the four structure generators, and the End World's rand

gpu: its former globals, function statics and lazily built tables are gone (lane/gpuenv, L2): per-environment state lives in struct env (csrc/engine/env.h), per-dimension state in the replay's dims, constant tables are built before main; csrc/tests/globals.sh lists what is left
struct pop_map: heap-grown starts array plus a jhm64 hash map whose iteration order is part of the semantics
struct populate: order scratch is heap-grown (order, cap_order)
notes: decorator_decorate and the decorator negatives are declared here and defined in decorator.c.
